rows.note: Use this as the usual term for field hockey and for hockey when no ice-specific distinction is intended.

example.english: I used to play field hockey and even competed for my school.
example.traditional: 我細個成日打曲棍球，仲代表學校出過賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 daa2 kuk1 gwan3 kau4 zung6 doi6 biu2 hok6 haau6 ceot1 gwo3 coi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for ice hockey, rather than the broader term 曲棍球.

example.english: I loved watching hockey matches when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個好鍾意睇冰球比賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 bing1 kau4 bei2 coi3
